name: UEA Time Series Classification Archive
description: A collection of multivariate time-series datasets for classification research, made available alongside the UCR archive as the UEA & UCR Time Series Classification repository.
citation: Bagnall, A., Dau, H. A., Lines, J., Flynn, M., Large, J., Bostrom, A., Southam, P., & Keogh, E. (2018). The UEA multivariate time series classification archive, 2018. arXiv:1811.00075. https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.1811.00075

license.identifier: Dataset-specific terms; not a standard SPDX identifier
